instructions: Original AI-authored challenging practice inspired by topics and style in the available teacher quizzes. Not a teacher paper or official mark scheme. Work independently under timed conditions; self-mark against the model points after submission.
description: Timed teacher-inspired mock with written answers and model marking points.

questions.text: Explain the difference between XOR and OR.

answer.text: OR outputs 1 when at least one input is 1
XOR outputs 1 when inputs differ; for 1,1 it outputs 0

questions.text: Describe gates needed to implement Y = NOT (A OR B).

answer.text: An OR gate combines A and B
A NOT gate inverts the result; equivalent to a NOR gate

questions.text: List outputs for a two-input XOR gate in input order 00, 01, 10, 11.
An alarm sounds when neither sensor A nor sensor B is active. Write an expression.

answer.text: Equivalently NOT A AND NOT B
